hook.name: DynamicFeeRebalanceHook
hook.description: Adjusts LP fees dynamically based on an EMA of tick movement (bounded by configurable min/max and max step per block), skims a configurable revenue share from each swap into ERC-6909 claims redeemable by the fee recipient, and emits non-custodial upward-rebalance suggestions when the pool price drifts above a configured tick threshold.
